name: Claude Code runs
notes: The guard, claims, the Claude panel, the plugin

features.feature: A minutes run can read only its call's folder (and the previous minutes of the meeting), write only `notes.md` and its actions file, and run only Echo's run commands, whatever the user's settings allow
A run is refused when admin policy can switch hooks off, or Claude Code is older than Echo needs
One run per call: a session's claim holds while its process works; an explicit Write minutes takes over a session's fresh claim, automatic minutes yield
A thread's sync runs may only read its ledger and write their own run files; a Yolo run may change only its own task
The Claude panel (status bar, ⌘`, ⌘K) runs the Echo-folder session; closing the window keeps it; Restart and New conversation ask first while it runs; it knows what the window shows
Connect Claude Code installs Echo's plugin where Echo's sessions run; older installs show in Health and the Inbox with Update it
The status line in a Claude Code session shows Echo, recording / armed / next meeting, and toasts a failed transcription or an expired arm
In a Claude Code session, /echo:doctor is quiet when Echo is fine and, with something missing (a permission), names it and opens its settings page without changing anything
In a Claude Code session, plain words arm, pin the language of and stop a recording ("record my next call in Ukrainian", "stop recording")
In a Claude Code session, the live pane follows a recording: a band above the prompt with [ Live ], the transcript as it comes, then a rolling summary, highlights and actions
